page.overview:
Who is Breaker?

Breaker was a clone trooper captain during the Clone Wars. He served under Admiral Wullf Yularen and General Obi-Wan Kenobi during the conquest on Geonosis.

Breaker wore the normal clone Phase I armor with gray stripes down the arms. He also wore a pauldron. His helmet was similar to clone trooper helmets except that its front was foldable and the visor was more closely related to Mandalorian helmets. He was also equipped with a jetpack, a Shoulder-mounted blaster on his right shoulder and a Wrist blaster on his left gauntlet.
